checkin: Thank you for booking, we look forward to flying with you! Passengers MUST call us at (908) 788-5415 for a weather check in call. Passengers will be advised if the weather is safe or not to fly at this call. Passengers will also be informed on which launch location we will use for the flight.
cancellation: Passengers have 72 hours (3 days) to cancel or change their reservation. The 72 hour period is measured backwards from the passenger show-up time (as specified in the Flight Confirmation e-mail sent to passengers) at the launch location on the day of their flight.
